text:
Devon: quick postmortem follow-up for INC-901 — dropping a compact action list, pls ack and update dates if needed. trying to avoid another ad-hoc sync.

Devon: actions (short):
- A1: infra: ensure fallback pool + autoscale policy is documented and testable — due 2024-06-12. owner: @Ozgur
- A2: runtime: add KV-cache regression test & perf guardrail in CI — due 2024-06-09. owner: @Maria C.
- A3: security: confirm audit log retention for private deployments (inc audit export) — due 2024-06-14. owner: @Ana
- A4: ops: runbook update + playbook snippet for partial degradation — due 2024-06-10. owner: @AJ
- A5: product: customer comms draft for affected customers — due 2024-06-11. owner: @Raj (PM)

Maria C.: ack A2, adding a CI job today. will post the test PR by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Ozgur: ack A1. I need one day to validate scaling triggers, target change to 2024-06-13 if that's ok? :thinking:

Devon: @Ozgur fine to push A1 one day — please note impact on A4 timeline if autoscale test slips.

AJ: ack A4. I'll paste the minimal playbook snippet here and link the runbook PR when ready.

AJ: ```
# runbook excerpt: partial degradation
If latency > 1200ms for 2m:
  - route traffic to fallback model variant
  - run diagnostics: `redwood diag --inc=901 --type=latency`
  - notify #eng-oncall and #incidents
```

SRE Bot: Jira INC-901-A1 created: https://jira/redwood/browse/INC-901-A1 assigned to Ozgur.

Ana: ack A3. Security will verify KMS policy and retention; can confirm by 2024-06-14 morning.

Raj (PM): ack A5. I'll draft customer note and share in #product-distro for review by 2024-06-10 so we can finalize on the 11th.

Katie: FYI I'm reassigning one code-review for the runtime change (A2) to @Maria C. to unblock the CI job. tagging @devops for capacity check. :eyes:

Maria C.: thanks @Katie — will review and merge after automated checks.

Devon: small cross-team dependency: A2 needs a stub from A4 (runbook command) for the CI guardrails. AJ if you can add `redwood diag` mock output to the test fixture that'd help.

AJ: yep I'll add a fixture — ETA tomorrow morning.

Ozgur: created a quick spike to validate autoscale thresholds; pushed notes to the A1 ticket. link: https://docs.svc/autoscale-spike-inc901

Maria C.: quick question — for the KV-cache regression test, do we run with quantized weights disabled? iirc that changes cache behavior.

Ana: security note — if private deployment audit export is >30d we need legal signoff. we'll flag if that becomes the proposal.

Devon: good catch @Maria C. — let's run the regression in two modes: quantized ON and OFF. update the ticket.

Ozgur: re A1 due shifting to 2024-06-13, A4 still holds at 2024-06-10 but AJ pls confirm you can still finish then if autoscale test slips one day.

AJ: I can keep A4 on 2024-06-10 as long as the fixture is available tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Katie: quick ping for cross-team reviewer on the runbook PR — tagging @Devon and @Raj (PM) for signoff after AJ posts it.

Devon: thanks all. final ask: everyone drop a short ack with updated date if you're shifting. I'll compile and close the loop by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
